title: Typographic Color
slide_intent: Teach a designer how a small text palette can keep a voice recognizable against a much broader range of backgrounds.
strategic_value: Instacart can vary its food-inspired fields while keeping letterforms anchored in Kale, Cashew or White.
demonstration: A two-row matrix repeats one letter specimen against ten fills. The text switches between dark and light treatments according to the ground.
practical_value: Compare the intended field with the specimen grid before choosing the approved text color. A photograph or graphic can carry additional hues.

content_islands.name: Text-color guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the title and the short rule in a wide header above the grid.

content_islands.name: Pairing specimens
content_islands.spec: Show the same large mixed-case sample centered inside every colored card. Keep card and type size constant so the contrast changes are easy to compare.
